description: The full content application: typed data layer sourced from the research JSON, the topic registry (two live topics + four coming-soon placeholders), reusable presentation components (with the mandatory visible StrengthBadge), the Home landing page, the data-driven Topic page, responsive data-driven navigation, and client routing. Depends on FEAT-001. This is the core of the site; after it, both research topics render fully on desktop and mobile.
steps: Copy .agents/research/jesus-is-god.json and .agents/research/jw-critique.json into src/data/content/ (keep filenames). These copies are the app's bundled data; the user edits these to extend content.

Create src/data/types.ts with: type Strength = 'scriptural' | 'strong' | 'supplementary'; interface Reference { citation; translationUsed; text }; interface OriginalLanguage { language; text; translit; note }; interface Argument { id; title; shortClaim; category; strength: Strength; primaryReferences: Reference[]; originalLanguage?: OriginalLanguage; nwtRebuttal?: string; explanation }; interface UncertainCitation { citation; issue }; interface TopicContent { title; subtitle?; disclaimer?; displayTranslation?; displayTranslationNote?; divineNameNote?; methodologyNote?; categories?: string[]; subCategories?: string[]; arguments: Argument[]; uncertainCitations?: UncertainCitation[] }; interface TopicMeta { id; navLabel; title; blurb; status: 'live' | 'coming-soon'; accent?; loadContent?: () => TopicContent }. originalLanguage and nwtRebuttal MUST be optional (jw-critique args omit them).

Create src/data/content/jesus-is-god.ts and src/data/content/jw-critique.ts: `import data from './<file>.json'; import type { TopicContent } from '../types'; export default data as unknown as TopicContent;`.

Create src/data/topics.ts: an ordered array of TopicMeta. Live: { id:'jesus-is-god', navLabel:'Jesus Is God', title:'The Divinity of Christ', blurb:..., status:'live', loadContent: () => jesusIsGod }, { id:'jw-critique', navLabel:"Jehovah's Witnesses", title:..., blurb:..., status:'live', loadContent: () => jwCritique }. Coming-soon (status:'coming-soon', no loadContent): trinity ('The Trinity'), eucharist ('The Real Presence'), papacy ('The Papacy'), marian ('Marian Doctrine'). Export helpers listTopics() and getTopicMeta(id).

Create src/components/StrengthBadge.tsx: a visible pill rendering the strength label (capitalized), colored per level — scriptural = gold/emerald solid, strong = amber, supplementary = muted slate. Include aria-label. This visible badge is a hard requirement.

Create src/components/ReferenceBlock.tsx (renders citation + translationUsed tag + verse text, styled as a scripture quote block) and src/components/OriginalLanguageBlock.tsx (renders language, original text in a larger serif/appropriate font, transliteration in italics, and the note; component is only rendered when originalLanguage is present).
Create src/components/Callout.tsx (titled note box with a variant prop e.g. 'info' | 'caveat' | 'disclaimer') and src/components/SectionHeader.tsx (category/section heading with count).

Create src/components/ArgumentCard.tsx: card showing title, <StrengthBadge>, shortClaim, the list of ReferenceBlocks, OriginalLanguageBlock when present, an NWT-rebuttal callout when nwtRebuttal is present, and the explanation. Mobile-first spacing and readable measure.

Create src/components/NavBar.tsx: sticky top nav driven by listTopics(); brand 'Ave Jesus Rex' links to '/'; live topics are links to /topic/:id, coming-soon shown as disabled/muted; responsive hamburger menu for narrow screens with accessible toggle (aria-expanded, keyboard-operable). Create src/components/Layout.tsx wrapping NavBar + <main> (<Outlet/>) + footer with a skip-to-content link.

Create src/pages/Home.tsx: hero section ('Ave Jesus Rex' / 'Hail Jesus the King' with a short mission line), then a responsive grid of topic cards from listTopics() — live cards link through, coming-soon cards show a 'Coming soon' tag and are non-interactive.

Create src/pages/TopicPage.tsx: read :topicId via useParams; getTopicMeta; if missing or coming-soon with no content, show a friendly message; else call loadContent(), render title/subtitle, intro callouts (disclaimer for jw-critique; displayTranslationNote/divineNameNote/methodologyNote for jesus-is-god), then group arguments by the topic's categories/subCategories order (fall back to arguments' own category order) into SectionHeader + ArgumentCard lists, and finally render uncertainCitations in a collapsible 'Honest caveats' section when present.
Rewrite src/App.tsx to use BrowserRouter with routes: '/' -> Home, '/topic/:topicId' -> TopicPage, '*' -> NotFound, all inside Layout. Remove the FEAT-001 placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` succeeds with no TypeScript errors (JSON imports typecheck against TopicContent).
The Argument type has originalLanguage and nwtRebuttal as optional, so jw-critique data (which lacks both) compiles.
StrengthBadge renders as a visible, color-differentiated pill for all three strength values.

Home lists all six topics (two live, four coming-soon); TopicPage renders all 22 jesus-is-god arguments grouped into its 6 categories and all 22 jw-critique arguments grouped into its 5 sub-categories.
Navigation is data-driven from the topic registry and works on a narrow (mobile) viewport.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 with no errors.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it passes.

OPTIONAL smoke test: start `npm run dev` in the background, sleep 2, run `curl -s http://localhost:5317 | grep -i 'ave jesus rex'` and confirm a match, then STOP the dev server (do not leave it running).
findings:
CONTENT APP COMPLETE. `npm run build` (tsc && vite build) and `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) both exit 0. Production build emits dist/index.html + assets/index-*.css (~16.4kB) + assets/index-*.js (~256kB raw / ~84kB gzip). dist/index.html contains 'Ave Jesus Rex'. OPTIONAL dev-server smoke test (npm run dev + curl :5317) was NOT run: the execution environment blocks any command that starts a server (dev/preview/host/port patterns are refused by a guard). Verified the built output statically instead (grep 'ave jesus rex' dist/index.html matches). No server was left running; port 5317 is free. No git run.

DATA SHAPE GOTCHA FEAT-003 MUST KNOW: the two research JSON files are NOT perfectly uniform, and the app handles the differences at render time, not by editing the research:
- jesus-is-god.json: top-level headline is `title`; `originalLanguage` is a STRUCTURED OBJECT {language,text,translit,note} (present on 16/22 args); `nwtRebuttal` present on all 22; has `categories` (6), `displayTranslation`, `displayTranslationNote`, `divineNameNote`, `methodologyNote`, `uncertainCitations` (6 entries, not 7).
- jw-critique.json: top-level headline is `topic` (NOT `title`); has `disclaimer`; `subCategories` (5); `originalLanguage`, WHERE PRESENT, is a PLAIN STRING (e.g. 'Greek: ...'), NOT the object; args have NO `nwtRebuttal` on most (a few do); NO `uncertainCitations`.
- Because of these, src/data/types.ts declares: Argument.originalLanguage?: OriginalLanguage | string (union, tolerant of both), Argument.nwtRebuttal?: string, and TopicContent adds optional `topic?` alongside `title?`-style fields. Both content/*.ts modules cast `data as unknown as TopicContent` so JSON imports compile regardless of per-file variance. OriginalLanguageBlock normalizes string-vs-object; TopicPage uses content.title || content.topic || meta.title for the heading.

TOPIC REGISTRY (src/data/topics.ts): ordered array `topics`, plus listTopics() and getTopicMeta(id). LIVE: 'jesus-is-god' (navLabel 'Jesus Is God', title 'The Divinity of Christ'), 'jw-critique' (navLabel "Jehovah's Witnesses", title 'Examining the Watch Tower'). COMING-SOON (status:'coming-soon', no loadContent): 'trinity' ('The Trinity'), 'eucharist' ('The Real Presence'), 'papacy' ('The Papacy'), 'marian' ('Marian Doctrine'). To publish a coming-soon topic later: add src/data/content/<id>.json + <id>.ts (import+cast like the others), then flip the registry entry to status:'live' and add loadContent:()=><module>. No routes/components need changes — /topic/:topicId is fully data-driven.

ROUTING: src/App.tsx uses <BrowserRouter> with a parent <Route element={<Layout/>}> wrapping '/' -> Home, '/topic/:topicId' -> TopicPage, '*' -> NotFound (react-router-dom ^6 API as noted in FEAT-001). NOTE for deploy/FEAT-003: BrowserRouter needs SPA fallback (serve index.html for unknown paths) if ever hosted on a static server; vite dev/preview handle this automatically.

COMPONENTS (src/components/): StrengthBadge (visible pill: scriptural=solid gold bg-gold-400/text-ink-900, strong=amber outline bg-gold-900/30, supplementary=muted bg-ink-700; has aria-label + title), ReferenceBlock (gold left-border scripture quote with citation + translation tag), OriginalLanguageBlock (handles object OR string; lang attr el/he), Callout (variants info|caveat|disclaimer|rebuttal), SectionHeader (title + argument count + id for anchor), ArgumentCard (title, StrengthBadge, shortClaim, ReferenceBlocks, OriginalLanguageBlock when present, nwtRebuttal Callout when present, explanation), NavBar (sticky, data-driven from listTopics(), desktop links + mobile hamburger with aria-expanded/aria-controls, live=links, coming-soon=muted non-link), Layout (skip-to-content link, NavBar, <main id='main-content'>, footer).

PAGES (src/pages/): Home (hero 'Ave Jesus Rex'/'Hail Jesus the King' + responsive topic card grid), TopicPage (useParams topicId -> getTopicMeta; missing->not-found msg, coming-soon->teaser msg; else loadContent(), intro Callouts [disclaimer / displayTranslationNote / divineNameNote / methodologyNote], groups args by categories||subCategories order with document-order fallback via sectionOrder(), SectionHeader+ArgumentCard per section, collapsible <details> 'Honest caveats' from uncertainCitations), NotFound (404 + home link). Section/argument ids are slugified for anchor scrolling (scroll-mt-24).

THEME: reused FEAT-001 tokens exactly (ink/parchment/gold scales, font-serif Cormorant / font-sans Inter). No new palette introduced. Mobile-first throughout (single-column default, sm:/md: breakpoints, >=44px tap targets on nav toggle, max-w-prose on body copy).
